messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Size of the data frame in created in RHIPE
parts:
Hello,

The maximum size of any key/value is 128MB. But you should not rely on that,
keep your keys/values as small as possible (< 2MB). RHIPE (and this is not a
good design in retrospect, will be fixed soon) loads in rhipe_map_buffsize
number of key,value pairs at one time (the length of map.values and map.keys),
and so if the average size of a value is 2MB, then the default of value of
rhipe_map_buffsize (5000) will use up 10GB!

So you'll always need to specify a small size of rhipe_map_buffsize. Data frame
sizes depend on the number of columns and type of the column. But size is not
the only issue. In the airline data set each data frame had somewhere around 2K
rows. The size was not large (< 100 KB ) but rhipe_map_buffsize was not changed
from the default, the example code would be rbind-ing 2K*5K == 10MM rows which
would take forever.

So if you have 5 MM rows, store each as data frames of e.g. 2000 rows and
forever specify a small value of rhipe_map_buffsize and do your computations
across blocks of data frames.

Cheers
Saptarshi
